Vocabulary
1. Law and Justice

               WORD                        MEANING
  Allegation                 A claim without proof
  Jurisdiction               Legal authority over a matter
  Affidavit                  Written statement sworn to be true
  Indictment                 Formal charge of a serious crime
  Litigation                 Legal proceedings
  Clemency                   Mercy, leniency
  Arbitration                Settling disputes outside court
  Statute                    A formal written law
  Conviction                 Formal declaration of guilt
  Immunity                   Legal protection from penalties


2. Politics and Governance

            WORD                         MEANING
  Bureaucracy                 A system of government run by
                              officials
  Autonomy                    Self-governance
  Coalition                   Alliance between parties/groups

Federalism               Division of powers in government
  Incumbent                Current office holder
  Manifesto                Policy statement of a party
  Plebiscite               Direct vote by people on an issue
  Repeal                   To revoke a law
  Secular                  Not religious
  Sovereignty              Supreme power or authority


3. Emotions and Behavior

               WORD                     MEANING
  Altruistic               Selfless
  Belligerent              Aggressive
  Benevolent               Kindly
  Callous                  Emotionally insensitive
  Complacent               Self-satisfied
  Cynical                  Distrustful of motives
  Empathetic               Understanding others' feelings
  Impulsive                Acting without thinking
  Melancholy               Sad and pensive
  Vindictive               Revengeful

4. Academia and Intelligence

              WORD                      MEANING
  Astute                   Perceptive
  Cogent                   Clear and convincing
  Erudite                  Scholarly
  Pedantic                 Overly concerned with rules
  Lucid                    Easy to understand
  Meticulous               Attention to detail
  Profound                 Deep and insightful
  Reticent                 Reserved or silent
  Sagacious                Wise
  Scholarly                Academic


5. Crime and Ethics

            WORD                      MEANING
  Fraudulent               Dishonest or deceptive
  Heinous                  Extremely wicked
  Illicit                  Illegal
  Incarcerate              To imprison
  Larceny                  Theft
  Malfeasance              Wrongdoing by public official
  Perjury                  Lying under oath

Recidivism            Repeat offending
  Reprehensible         Deserving blame
  Unethical             Morally wrong



6. Media and Communication

               WORD                 MEANING
  Articulate            Clear in speech
  Assertion             A confident statement
  Euphemism             Mild expression for harsh reality
  Hyperbole             Exaggeration
  Irony                 Opposite of literal meaning
  Jargon                Specialized language
  Rhetoric              Persuasive speaking
  Satire                Criticizing through humor
  Stereotype            Oversimplified image or idea
  Verbatim              Word for word
